message: Thanks to all for the kind words. I feel like I ought to provide at least a little balance here, however: several of the young men I shook hands with or remembered from past visits are murderers. One of the prison's few women at the ceremony killed both her parents. Other inmates, my brother included, are serving time for armed robbery. As pleasant and friendly as the people I met were, I can't entirely separate the deed from the person -- and I think that equation of deed with person, of character with action, is what so informs the throw-away-the-key argument. Still, the very fact that it was a graduations ceremony reminded me, as a teacher, of my fundamental belief that people can and do (and *must*) change.
